# Hindsight Chess

> Free chess game review for Chess.com and Lichess. Enter a username or paste a PGN and Stockfish 19, running in the browser, rates every move from Brilliant to Blunder, explains mistakes and shows the better move. No account; up to 60 new reviews a day. Also available as an Android app.

## Guides

- [How it works](https://hindsight.almadih.dev/how-it-works): engine depths, the winning-chances formula, the ten verdicts and their thresholds, accuracy, limits
- [How to review a chess game](https://hindsight.almadih.dev/how-to-review-a-chess-game): step-by-step guide to reviewing a Chess.com or Lichess game
- [What makes a move brilliant](https://hindsight.almadih.dev/brilliant-move): the exact test for a Brilliant move, with Morphy's Opera Game as the example
- [How chess accuracy works](https://hindsight.almadih.dev/chess-accuracy): move and game accuracy formulas and a per-rating-band comparison with Chess.com
